item.description:
New • Rename any session, local or remote. Double-click the title in the transcript or use Rename in the list's right-click menu • Open a shell on a remote host in the session's project folder, or copy the SSH command, from the right-click menu • Remote transcripts refresh as the session moves on, with a button to fetch the latest on demand • Clicking a "session went quiet" notification opens that remote session • The MCP transcript tool reads remote sessions when given a host
Improved • A remote host that misses a poll keeps its sessions on screen, marked with when they were last synced • Hosts that keep failing are retried less often, so a dead box no longer costs a connection attempt every minute • Settings > Agents distinguishes "actvt-cli not installed", "actvt-cli failed" and "unreachable", shows last sync and CLI version per host, and has a Sync now button • The Linux actvt-cli is a static build and now runs on Amazon Linux 2023 and RHEL 9. Re-run the install command on hosts where it failed to start • The Claude usage card shows when it will retry after a rate limit • Clicking a session notification always opens the session in Actvt
Fixed • A remote host whose CLI could not start was reported as unreachable • Releases no longer fail on a truncated package download or an unavailable MCP registry

New • Resume in Terminal opens the terminal you actually use. Ghostty, iTerm2, WezTerm, kitty and Alacritty join Terminal.app, and Actvt matches the one your agents already run in without being told. Pick a specific one in Settings > Agents if you would rather choose • Focus Window now finds sessions running inside tmux. Actvt locates the pane, switches tmux to it and brings its window forward, instead of reporting that the session has no window. Named sockets and more than one tmux server are handled too • Copy a session's ID from the top of the inspector, or from the right-click menu on any session in the list. It is what claude --resume and Actvt's MCP tools ask for, and until now the only way to get it was to read it off a filename
Improved • The Claude usage card can refresh an expired token in place. Signing in to Claude Code another way, a setup token from CI or a secret manager, left the card blank for someone who was demonstrably signed in, with nothing they could do about it from inside Actvt • A token that can never read usage now says so instead of asking you to sign in again. A setup token carries the wrong scope, so re-authenticating could not have fixed it • The PII detection settings and the transcript's AI scanning label are now translated in German and French
Fixed • Resume no longer opens the new session behind the windows you already had. macOS was bringing the terminal you were already looking at to the front rather than the one Actvt had just opened, which read as "it opened my terminal but did not resume anything" • Resume works if your shell is fish. The command Actvt sent used a grouping syntax that fish reads as something else entirely, so it failed before it started • Notifications no longer arrive for a tmux session you are already watching. Actvt could not tell that a pane was on screen, so that check never applied to tmux at all • The terminal named in a launch error is now the one that actually ran, so the permission it asks you to grant is the one that would help

New • See how full a live session's context is, in the session list and the inspector. The menu bar stays quiet until a session passes 70% of its window, then says how full it is • Get warned before a session fills up. Turn on Context filling in Settings > Notifications and pick a threshold; it re-arms after each compaction • Burn rate: what a run is costing per hour, measured over its last five minutes of activity. A measurement, not a forecast • Spend at a glance in the Overview: today, the last 7 days and the last 30 days, each next to your own average for that window • The usage card now shows what you've spent in the current billing block • Ports say who opened them. Monitor shows the agent session and project behind each listening port, marks it Orphaned once that session ends, and can notify you when a session leaves ports behind • Export any session list as CSV or JSON, with the filters you applied • Add extra session directories in Settings > Agents, for Claude Code projects kept outside the default location
Improved • Session outcomes no longer depend on colour. Finished, errored and unknown were three dots of the same shape in green, red and grey; they're now a filled circle, a ring, a dash and a diamond • Cost data now carries each model's context window, so the meter stays right for new models without waiting for an app update
Fixed • Meaning search no longer reports success when it indexed nothing • When the meaning index is unavailable, search falls back to full text instead of returning no results
